_doc: Mutable campaign state. The driver reads it to decide whether to start a cycle; the cycle updates it at the end. A fresh session with no context can resume the campaign from this file alone.
last_cycle_outcome: P18 ITERATE. The connectome relabelling study for (H64, H42) PASSED, so H64's LAST connectome gate is closed: audit.py --gate promotion --datasets connectome now EXITS 0 and every connectome check passes. H64 was still NOT promoted, and the rule that decides it is the campaign's own -- campaign.yaml line 140: 'promotion_gate.primary is UNCHANGED: both primaries are still required to promote'. The blocker is now microns ALONE, and microns turns out to be UNMEASURABLE on this box as configured. STUDY: 5 points (identity + R=4, R fixed from campaign.yaml, prereg sealed and COMMITTED at 040330f 7 s before launch). Identity anchor reproduced both recorded confirm means EXACTLY (abs diff 0.0 pp). All 5 deltas positive: min +0.104084, max +0.146724, mean +0.128394, sd 0.021196, paired one-sided 95% lower bound +0.108186 vs a 0.012 bar. The CANONICAL labelling is the WORST of the five, so the number on disk is conservative by ~23%. MICRONS RE-MEASURED, NOT ASSUMED: the 3 missing confirm seeds were re-run on a fresh sweep and ALL THREE truncated again (82.94085078/3502.6 s, 83.22104843/3493.7 s, 83.22104843/3487.1 s). Tally on this box: 6 of 8 H64 microns runs truncated, plus 1 of 1 unmodified-champion control runs. TWO CORRECTIONS THIS CYCLE. (1) The -0.271 pp microns figure cycle 16 carried forward is an ARTIFACT OF POOLING truncated runs with clean ones. The 2 runs that actually completed the pipeline are +0.00534396 pp OVER the champion, ABOVE microns' 0.002 bar. H64 on microns is UNMEASURED, not negative -- which removes the 'gain that lives on one dataset' objection, the strongest substantive argument against H64. (n=2 and bit-identical, so it is a correction, not promotion evidence.) (2) Cycle 16's 'the box degrades under sustained load' diagnosis is WRONG. The P18 study ran 10 connectome arms over 3.8 h with NO monotone wall trend, and the microns re-runs were alone on the GPU and still truncated with DECREASING walls. The real cause is a ~1% RUNTIME MARGIN: H42's own clean runs were 3397.8-3418.0 s against a 3450 s deadline. Raising reserve_s makes it WORSE (time_limit = cap - reserve); scheduling microns first does not help. The fix is to re-size microns as a normal variant through the full ladder (H62's move). TWO FINDINGS BEYOND THE VERDICT: the H42 arm's relabelling std is 0.019124 pp, an exact independent replication of M10's cycle-9 constant on a different variant pair; and H64's own std is 0.006007 pp, 3.2x SMALLER, so the asymmetric surrogate is markedly MORE label-robust than the sigmoid it replaces (invisible to seeds, which are degenerate -- only relabelling can see it). Corollary: the paired design does NOT cancel for a NON-NESTED pair (paired sd 0.021196 > comparator sd 0.019124, ~= the independent-combination value 0.020045), which refines M10 and is filed as P21. P22 filed for the label-robustness mechanism.

An attribution control proved the microns failure is the MACHINE: the unmodified champion H42 also truncated on the same box (3495.3 s, degraded) - P07 confirmed and refiled as P19. Mechanism: pure +0.308221, sift +0.204094, final +0.104084, so the pure->final transfer is 33.8% and M1's open composition clause is CLOSED affirmatively. Reach measured NOT to be the mechanism (ASYM 13.10% of backward weight live vs sigmoid 15.66%), falsifying H65's premise for free. Verifier and critic rungs were run inline, not by independent subagents.

Connectome relabelling study for (H64, H42): PASSED. relabel_gate.evaluate() passed=True -- identity anchor exact (abs diff 0.0 pp), min-rule 0 failures (all 5 deltas in [+0.104084, +0.146724]), paired one-sided 95% lower bound +0.108186 vs a 0.012 bar. audit.py --gate promotion --datasets connectome goes exit 1 -> exit 0; relabel.connectome FAIL -> PASS; every connectome gate now passes. NO CHAMPION CHANGED and sota.json was NOT touched: campaign.yaml line 140 requires BOTH primaries, and microns is unmeasurable here. The 3 missing microns confirm seeds were re-run on a fresh sweep and all 3 truncated (6 of 8 overall, plus the unmodified champion's own control). Corrected cycle 16 twice: the -0.271 pp microns delta is an artifact of pooling truncated runs (the 2 clean runs are +0.005344 pp, above bar), and the 'degrades under sustained load' diagnosis is wrong -- it is a ~1% runtime margin (3397.8-3418.0 s against a 3450 s deadline), so reserve_s makes it worse and scheduling alone does not help. Two findings beyond the verdict: M10's 0.019124 pp constant replicated exactly on a different pair, and ASYM is 3.2x more label-robust than the sigmoid (0.006007 vs 0.019124) -- invisible to degenerate seed pools. Paired design does NOT cancel for a non-nested pair -> P21; label-robustness mechanism -> P22. gates_run omits screen and confirm DELIBERATELY: P18 produces no variant, so there is nothing to screen and H64's confirm pool already existed. The 3 microns runs were a P19 re-measurement, not a confirm rung. Critic rung was inline, not an independent subagent.

_escalation_note: cycles_since_score_move is the PRIMARY divergence trigger as of 2026-08-15 (campaign.yaml escalation.divergent_after_k_cycles_without_score_move: 3). Increment it at the end of EVERY cycle regardless of verdict; reset to 0 only on a champion change. It replaces consecutive_kills as the primary trigger because that counter never left 0 in 7 cycles - 4 of them were infrastructure items, which by construction never increment it, and both science items passed. At 3 the campaign is FORCED out of incremental mode and an infrastructure item no longer satisfies the requirement.
